senses.zh_definition: 佐助：日语人名；在《火影忍者》语境中通常指宇智波佐助。
senses.en_definition: A Japanese personal name; in Naruto contexts, Sasuke Uchiha.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas Jepun; dalam konteks Naruto, merujuk kepada watak Sasuke Uchiha.
senses.nuances: 此处为专名释义，不是已核实的DBP普通词释义。规范书写应为Sasuke；没有上下文时，不能断定必指《火影忍者》角色。角色身份见[NARUTO官方网站](https://naruto-official.com/en/news/01_1856)。

senses.zh_definition: SASUKE：日本TBS制作的障碍挑战电视节目及其节目品牌。
senses.en_definition: The Japanese obstacle-course television programme and format SASUKE, associated internationally with Ninja Warrior.
senses.ms_definition: Nama rancangan televisyen dan format pertandingan berhalangan terbitan TBS di Jepun.
senses.nuances: 这是节目专名，与人物Sasuke须按上下文区分；品牌通常写作SASUKE。身份见[TBS节目资料](https://www.tbscontents.com/jp/top/aboutus.html)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran itu menampilkan ilustrasi watak Sasuke Uchiha daripada siri Naruto.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该展览展出了《火影忍者》角色宇智波佐助的插画。
dual_scenarios.en: The exhibition features illustrations of Sasuke Uchiha from the Naruto series.

etymology.historical_story: Sasuke belongs here as a Japanese proper name rather than an established Malay common word. The official Naruto site identifies Sasuke Uchiha, while TBS documents SASUKE as its obstacle-course television format. These distinct references explain why context is essential; neither source establishes a Malay lexical meaning or a Malay derivational family. Sources: [NARUTO](https://naruto-official.com/en/news/01_1856), [TBS](https://www.tbscontents.com/jp/top/aboutus.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到Sasuke先想“名字”，再看上下文：Naruto指佐助，TBS或障碍挑战指节目。
